figures.label: Spots of my pick
figures.method: I read the spots from options.json.
figures.recipe: import json;d=json.load(open('options.json'));o=d['options'];b=max(x['steps'][-1]['score'] for x in o);p=o[min((x['steps'][-1]['disruption']['score'],i) for i,x in enumerate(o) if x['steps'][-1]['score']>=b-1)[1]];s=[t['score'] for t in p['steps']];r=next(i for i,v in enumerate(s) if v>=s[0]+d['share']*(s[-1]-s[0])-1e-9);print(sum(1 for w in p['works'] if w.get('spot')))
